skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply principles of supply chain management in agricultural businesses.
Analyze financial statements and manage financial risks in agricultural businesses.
Identify and mitigate various types of risks in agricultural operations.
Manage fixed assets effectively to optimize performance and profitability.
Develop leadership skills necessary for effective management in agricultural businesses.
Implement internal control systems and quality management practices in agricultural businesses.
Conduct comprehensive business analysis using various analytical tools and techniques.
Apply problem-solving techniques to real-world business scenarios in agriculture.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and make informed decisions in agricultural contexts.
Improve communication skills through group discussions and presentations.
Work collaboratively with peers in group projects and presentations.
Demonstrate ability to learn independently and apply new knowledge to practical situations.
